summary: Iteration 90: Comprehensive testing of Excel Import/Export and Family Financial Tracking features. All backend tests passed (9/9). All frontend features working correctly - Settings Quick Actions show 'Import from Excel' and 'Family Hub', Import Data page has download template and upload buttons, Family Hub shows 'Sharma Family' with 3 members (Rahul, Priya, Son), combined summary displays net worth/investments/assets/loans, add member form works with name/relationship/email fields, copy invite code button present, dashboard family toggle shows Personal dropdown with family members.

issues: HTML validation warning: <button> nested inside another <button> in member list (remove button inside member row button). This causes hydration errors in React.
design_issues.note: Functional but technically invalid HTML structure

action_items: OPTIONAL: Fix nested button issue in FamilyPage.js - the remove member button is nested inside the member row button. Consider restructuring so the outer element is a div with onClick, not a button.
critical_code_review_comments: FamilyPage.js line 244-262: Button nested inside button - the member row is a <button> that contains another <button> for remove. This is invalid HTML and React warns about it. Fix by making outer element a div.
seed_data_creation: Used existing Sharma Family with members: Rahul Sharma (Self), Priya Sharma (Wife), Son
context_for_next_testing_agent: Excel Import/Export and Family Tracking features fully implemented and tested. Settings → Quick Actions shows Import from Excel and Family Hub. /import-data page has 3 steps with download template and upload buttons. /family page shows Sharma Family with invite code B09067C5, combined summary (Net Worth ₹1.50 Cr), and 3 members. Dashboard has family toggle dropdown when family has >1 member - allows switching between Personal view and family member views. Backend APIs all working: GET /api/data/sample-excel returns Excel blob, GET /api/family returns family with members, GET /api/family/combined-summary returns aggregated finances, GET /api/family/member/{id}/summary returns individual member data.
